findings.summary: MergeStage._publish_release guards RELEASE_HEAD_ADVANCED only when the local line branch resolves ('observed and frozen'). If configure found the line branch absent (no local branch synced, frozen is empty) and another order created or advanced the remote branch before this merger ran, the guard is skipped, _stripped_commit builds a parentless commit, and the --force-with-lease push replaces the remote line branch -- silently discarding the other order's landed commits, against behavior contract 3's pre-push recheck ('被他人前进则失败留痕…不覆盖他人提交'). Reachable when two orders on a fresh line race branch creation; not covered by test_it_creates_the_branch_when_absent (absent at merge) nor by the frozen 13/14 probes. Remedy: refuse when observed is set and frozen is empty (CAS basis unverifiable -- re-run configure).

The release-path probe (ls-remote) and push bypass the retry_remote egress wrapper the legacy path uses (dd_scripts.py:721-728), while MergeStage's docstring (dd_scripts.py:533-535) and dd_runner.py:393-395 claim transport-class failures retry under the stage fence. A transient network failure on the probe (returncode != 2) or the push becomes a non-retried MERGE_REFUSED repo verdict -- misclassified and requiring re-dispatch instead of an in-fence retry.
